owner: Open Access Data Centres (OADC) / WIOCC Group
notes: OADC Isando (JNB1) at 26 Electron Ave, Isando (Ekurhuleni): carrier-neutral hyperscale core facility, ~7MW site load over 1,600+ sqm per OADC datasheet (OCOLO lists 12MW); phase 1 went >90% full within a year, phase 2 launched ~Q1 2024; Uptime Institute Tier-III design certification. JINX Internet Exchange expanded to OADC JNB1 as an additional peering point (INX-ZA, 2026).
